title: Future Juice Rainbow Candy  Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Future Juice’s Rainbow Candy is a vibrant medley of fruit-flavoured confectionary, blending a spectrum of juicy, tangy, and sweet notes for an irresistibly nostalgic vape. A mix of Berry, Citrus, and Tropical flavours creates a bold and lively profile, delivering punchy bursts of sugary sweetness with every puff. The balance of tart and sweet replicates the familiar taste of colourful, chewy Candy, making this a perfect choice for vapers with a sweet tooth. Blended at 70% VG / 30% PG, this high-VG e-liquid is designed for sub-ohm vaping, producing thick clouds and rich, full-bodied flavour. Ideal for high-powered vape kits and sub-ohm tanks, it offers a smooth and intensely fruity vape experience. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, while nic salt shots offer a milder throat hit compared to freebase nicotine. Future Juice is a UK-based e-liquid manufacturer dedicated to crafting premium blends with bold, layered flavours. Their shortfill range combines classic dessert and fruit-inspired profiles, designed for vapers who enjoy rich, satisfying e-liquids.
